```{r}
## check log-likelihood over many units
U = 20
reps = 5

pp = list()
for(u in 1:U){
  pp[[u]] = list()
  for (i in 1:rep){
    pp[[u]][[i]] = runif(u)
  }
}

mod_lex = cmdstan_model(here("models","Likelihood_test", "poisson_binomial_lex.stan"))
mod_dyn = cmdstan_model(here("models","likelihood_test", "poisson_binomial_dynamic.stan"))

fits = list()

for (u in 1:U){
  fits[[u]] = list()
  for (i in 1:rep){
    data_stan = list(N = u, theta = pp[[u]][[i]])
    f_lex = mod_lex$sample(data = data_stan, iter_sampling = 1, chains = 1, fixed_param = T)
    f_dyn = mod_dyn$sample(data = data_stan, iter_sampling = 1, chains = 1, fixed_param = T)
    
    log_lik = log(dpoisbinom(0:u, pp[[u]][[i]]))
    
    draws_lex = as_draws_df(f_lex$draws()) %>% select(-contains('.')) %>% pivot_longer(cols = everything()) %>% pull(value)
    draws_dyn = as_draws_df(f_dyn$draws()) %>% select(-contains('.')) %>% pivot_longer(cols = everything()) %>% pull(value)
    
    df = data.frame(sim = log_lik, est_lex = draws_lex, est_dyn = draws_dyn)
    fits[[u]][[i]] = df
  }
}
```


```{r}
# Check outcome
df_diff = data.frame(u = numeric(), rep = numeric(), diff_lex = numeric(), diff_dyn = numeric())
for (u in 1:U){
  for(i in 1:rep){
    diff = fits[[u]][[i]] %>% mutate(diff_dyn = sim - est_dyn, diff_lex = sim - est_lex)
    
    df_diff = df_diff %>% add_row(u = u, rep = i, diff_lex = mean(diff$diff_lex), diff_dyn = mean(diff$diff_dyn))
  }
  
}

```


```{r}
# Check with 1 unit and fixed t_sigma 
U = 1
rep = 50
N = 200

sim_list = list()

for (i in 1:rep){
   Stim = seq(0, 20, length.out = N)
   
   t_sigma = exp(rnorm(1, 0.8,0.4))
   t_mu = rnorm(1, 10, 2)
   
   pp = pnorm((Stim-t_mu)/t_sigma)
   
   df_sim = data.frame(S = Stim, pp = pp, t_mu = t_mu, t_sigma= t_sigma ) %>% group_by(S) %>% mutate(Y = rpoisbinom(1,pp))
   sim_list[[i]] = df_sim
}

mod_lex = cmdstan_model(here("models","Likelihood_test", "U1_lex.stan"))
mod_dyn = cmdstan_model(here("models","Likelihood_test", "U1_dyn.stan"))

fits = list()

for (i in 1:rep){
  fits[[i]] = list()
  data_stan = list(
    Resp = sim_list[[i]]$Y, 
    U = U, 
    N = N, 
    Stim = sim_list[[i]]$S, 
    t_sigma = unique(sim_list[[i]]$t_sigma)
  )
  
  tryCatch({
    print("lexicographic")
    f_lex = mod_lex$sample(data = data_stan, iter_warmup = 500, iter_sampling = 500, 
                           chains = 4, parallel_chains = 4, init = 10, 
                           show_messages = FALSE, refresh = 0)
    
    print("dynamic")
    f_dyn = mod_dyn$sample(data = data_stan, iter_warmup = 500, iter_sampling = 500, 
                           chains = 4, parallel_chains = 4, init = 10, 
                           show_messages = FALSE, refresh = 0)
    
    # Extraction lives inside the tryCatch block so it only runs if sampling succeeds
    fits[[i]][["sum_dyn"]]   = f_dyn$summary()
    fits[[i]][["sum_lex"]]   = f_lex$summary()
    fits[[i]][["dia_dyn"]]   = f_dyn$sampler_diagnostics(format = "draws_df")
    fits[[i]][["dia_lex"]]   = f_lex$sampler_diagnostics(format = "draws_df")
    fits[[i]][['draws_dyn']] = f_dyn$draws(format = "draws_df")
    fits[[i]][['draws_lex']] = f_lex$draws(format = "draws_df")
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Caught an error, moving on: ", e$message)
  })
}

## Verdict attempt 1: cannot start sampling if t_sigma is too low
```


```{r}
# Check cut-off for t_sigma 
U = 1
rep = 50
N = 200
t_sigma_seq = seq(from = 0.5,to = 2.5, length.out =rep)

sim_list = list()

for (i in 1:rep){
   Stim = seq(0, 20, length.out = N)
   
   t_sigma = t_sigma_seq[i]#change to a space from 0.5 to 2.5
   t_mu = rnorm(1, 10, 2)
   
   pp = pnorm((Stim-t_mu)/t_sigma)
   
   df_sim = data.frame(S = Stim, pp = pp, t_mu = t_mu, t_sigma= t_sigma ) %>% group_by(S) %>% mutate(Y = rpoisbinom(1,pp))
   sim_list[[i]] = df_sim
}

mod_dyn = cmdstan_model(here("models","Likelihood_test", "U1_dyn.stan"))

fits = list()

for (i in 1:rep){
  fits[[i]] = list()
  data_stan = list(
    Resp = sim_list[[i]]$Y, 
    U = U, 
    N = N, 
    Stim = sim_list[[i]]$S, 
    t_sigma = unique(sim_list[[i]]$t_sigma)
  )
  
  tryCatch({
    f_dyn = mod_dyn$sample(data = data_stan, iter_warmup = 500, iter_sampling = 500, 
                           chains = 4, parallel_chains = 4, init = 10, 
                           show_messages = FALSE, refresh = 0)
    
    # Extraction lives inside the tryCatch block so it only runs if sampling succeeds
    fits[[i]][["sum"]]   = f_dyn$summary()
    fits[[i]][["dia"]]   = f_dyn$sampler_diagnostics(format = "draws_df")
    fits[[i]][['draws']] = f_dyn$draws(format = "draws_df")
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Caught an error, moving on: ", e$message)
  })
}
```

```{r}
}

mod_dyn = cmdstan_model(here("models","Likelihood_test", "U1_dyn.stan"))

for (i in 1:rep){

    fits[[i]][['draws_dyn']] = f_dyn$draws(format = "draws_df")
```

```{r}
# Investigate both approaches
sim_df = bind_rows(sim_list, .id = "rep") %>% ungroup() %>% select(t_mu, t_sigma, rep) %>% distinct() %>% pivot_longer(cols=c(t_mu, t_sigma), names_to= "parameter", values_to = "value" )

sum_lex = map_dfr(fits, ~ .x[["sum_lex"]], .id = "rep") %>% filter(variable %in% c("t_mu", "t_sigma")) %>% 
  left_join(sim_df, by = c("rep"="rep", 'variable' ="parameter"))

sum_dyn = map_dfr(fits, ~ .x[["sum_dyn"]], .id = "rep") %>% filter(variable %in% c("t_mu", "t_sigma")) %>% 
  left_join(sim_df, by = c("rep"="rep", 'variable' ="parameter"))

dyn_tmu = ggplot(sum_dyn %>% filter(variable == "t_mu")) + geom_point(aes(x = value, y = mean))+
  geom_errorbar(aes(x=value,ymin=q5, ymax = q95))+
  theme_classic()+labs(title = "dynamic")+geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1)

lex_tmu = ggplot(sum_lex %>% filter(variable == "t_mu")) + geom_point(aes(x = value, y = mean))+
  geom_errorbar(aes(x=value,ymin=q5, ymax = q95))+geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1)+
  theme_classic()+labs(title = "lexicographic")

dyn_tmu/lex_tmu

dyn_tsigma = ggplot(sum_dyn %>% filter(variable == "t_sigma")) + geom_point(aes(x = value, y = mean))+
  geom_errorbar(aes(x=value,ymin=q5, ymax = q95))+
  theme_classic()+labs(title = "dynamic")+geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1)

lex_tsigma = ggplot(sum_lex %>% filter(variable == "t_sigma")) + geom_point(aes(x = value, y = mean))+
  geom_errorbar(aes(x=value,ymin=q5, ymax = q95))+geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1)+
  theme_classic()+labs(title = "lexicographic")

dyn_tsigma|lex_tsigma
```

```{r}
#test with multiple units and shared sigma 

mod_lex = cmdstan_model(here("models","Likelihood_test", "MU_lex.stan"))
mod_dyn = cmdstan_model(here("models","Likelihood_test", "MU_dyn.stan"))

fit_model = function(N){
  U = sample(1:10, 1)
  
  Stim = seq(0, 20, length.out = N)
  
  t_mu_mu = 10
  t_mu_sigma = exp(rnorm(1, 0.5,0.3))

  t_sigma = exp(rnorm(1, 0.8,0.4))
  
  t_mu = sort(rnorm(U, t_mu_mu, t_mu_sigma))
  
  Units =  expand.grid(unit = seq_len(U),Stim = Stim) %>%mutate(t_mu = t_mu[unit]) %>% mutate(pp = pnorm((Stim-t_mu)/t_sigma)) %>% 
    mutate(t_sigma = t_sigma, t_mu_mu = t_mu_mu, t_mu_sigma = t_mu_sigma, U = U) 
  
  outcome = Units %>% group_by(Stim) %>% summarise(Y = rpoisbinom(1, pp))
  
  data_stan = list(Y = outcome$Y,  U = U,  N = N, S = Stim)
  
  print("lexicographic")
  f_lex = mod_lex$sample(data = data_stan, iter_warmup = 1000, iter_sampling = 1000, 
                           chains = 4, parallel_chains = 4, adapt_delta = 0.99)
  
  print("dynamic")
    f_dyn = mod_dyn$sample(data = data_stan, iter_warmup = 1000, iter_sampling = 1000, 
                           chains = 4, parallel_chains = 4, adapt_delta = 0.99)
  
  sum_dyn = f_dyn$summary()
  sum_lex = f_lex$summary()
  dia_dyn = f_dyn$sampler_diagnostics(format = "draws_df") %>% select(divergent__, treedepth__)
  dia_lex = f_lex$sampler_diagnostics(format = "draws_df") %>% select(divergent__, treedepth__)
  draws_dyn = f_dyn$draws(format = "draws_df") %>% select(-contains("pp")) %>% select(-contains("."))
  draws_lex = f_lex$draws(format = "draws_df") %>% select(-contains("pp")) %>% select(-contains("."))
  time_lex = f_lex$time()$total
  time_dyn = f_dyn$time()$total
  
  return(list(sim_out = outcome, sim_units = Units,sum_dyn   = sum_dyn,sum_lex   = sum_lex, dia_dyn   = dia_dyn, dia_lex   = dia_lex,
    draws_dyn = draws_dyn,draws_lex = draws_lex, time_lex  = time_lex, time_dyn  = time_dyn ))
  
  
}

plan(multisession, workers = 1)

runs = expand.grid(rep = 1:12)

safe_fit <- purrr::possibly(fit_model,otherwise = NULL)

qq <- future_map(1:nrow(runs),~safe_fit(N=200),.options = furrr_options(seed = TRUE),.progress = TRUE)

#saveRDS(qq, file = here("fits", "fits_lex_dyn.rds"))
```
